# unifi_setting_super_sdn (Resource)

The `unifi_setting_super_sdn` resource manages the UniFi SDN (Ubiquiti cloud account) association settings of a console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_super_sdn" "example" {
  # Whether the UniFi SDN (Ubiquiti cloud account) association is enabled.
  enabled = true

  # Whether the console has been migrated to the cloud account model.
  migrated = true

  # Whether Single Sign-On login is enabled for the SDN association.
  sso_login_enabled = "true"

  # Authentication token used to associate the console with the cloud account.
  # This value is sensitive - prefer supplying it via a variable.
  # auth_token = var.sdn_auth_token

  # Specify the site (optional, defaults to site configured in provider, otherwise "default")
  # site = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) The authentication token used to associate the console with the Ubiquiti cloud account.
- `device_id` (String) The device identifier registered with the UniFi SDN cloud.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the UniFi SDN cloud association is enabled.
- `migrated` (Boolean) Whether the console has been migrated to the UniFi SDN cloud account model.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `sso_login_enabled` (String) Whether Single Sign-On (SSO) login is enabled for the SDN association.
- `ubic_uuid` (String) The Ubiquiti cloud (UBIC) UUID associated with the console.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
